summary.text: Father of Sphelus (`sphelus-athenian`) and grandfather of the Athenian captain Iasus (`iasus-athenian`) — attested by Homer when Aeneas slew Iasus in the battle at the ships.

story.text: Homer names Iasus captain of the Athenians, called the son of Sphelus, son of Bucolus, when Apollo roused the Trojans and Aeneas smote him among the foremost fighters.
